Keyboard shortcuts Esc to close

Image

← → ↑ ↓ nudge image 1 px

Shift+arrows ×10 · Alt+arrows ×0.1

A auto-fit image to the chip grid · P pick 4 corners to assist auto-fit

R reset image · M centre image

\ show original / corrected

Tools

V move · D distort · P pick corners · C crop

Distort: drag corner / side · Alt+side bends

Pick corners: click 4 outer corner wells · drag to adjust · Backspace remove last · Enter fit · Esc cancel

Enter apply crop (image only) · Esc cancel

Crop to array (Crop panel / “array only”): show + export only the wells plus half a well (or your choice); switches on after Auto-fit

⌘/Ctrl+Z undo crop

Grid

G show / hide grid

[ ] square size −/+ (manual grid only)

{ } spacing −/+ (manual grid)

View

+ − zoom · F/0 fit · 1 100%

Space+drag pan · ⌘/Ctrl+wheel zoom

File

⌘/Ctrl+O open · ⌘/Ctrl+E export

⌘/Ctrl+S Save settings…

Load settings… in the top bar, or drop a settings JSON file onto the workspace. Open the image too; settings files contain no picture.

Settings

Click or Tab to a slider, then ← → / ↑ ↓ adjust it by a set step (e.g. 1 px, 0.01 strength, 0.5°). Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1. Esc returns arrows to the image.
